name: [V2.4] Boss Battle Sandbox
desc:
(V2.8) Summer Update

💥Boss Battle Sandbox is a sandbox-battleground game with boss fights from UT/DR, Ultrakill, multiple animes and more!

⚔ Gear up to fight bosses, other players or even play as bosses!

✨Play in Private servers for more sandboxing content! (Gear panel, map panel, exclusive morphs, and many more!) You'll also get free admin there too!

💎Plus players receive a Diamond great sword every time they spawn.💎
